question_W1_010.answer: Yes, as a matter of precision and not of substance. The entry should say that the formula of 2:27 is held in the loose class only, the same treatment given to 2:10 in W1-006. The formula at 2:27 is a real answering formula, not a token artifact: the answering verb is word 1 and the saying verb is word 5, with the name, a preposition and the king between them, so the strict pattern, which allows exactly one word between, cannot match it and the loose pattern does. The entry as it stands pools a strict-class verse and a loose-only verse under one key name that the inventory does not use, and it now disagrees in detail with the device notes of its own row. No edge of the row rests on it: 2:27 is interior to 2:24-2:30. Severity low; it is unchanged text, so it stands in extra_findings and not in items.
